headline: Oracle E-Business Suite RCE targeted days after patch; PHP2Shell CISA deadline is tomorrow; GMO tells customers to disconnect PCs

bullets.text: New: hackers are targeting a critical Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw (CVE-2026-101767) days after Oracle's patch. Separately, the ShinyHunters-exploited PeopleSoft zero-day turned out to be three chained flaws, including CVE-2026-35273.

China-linked hackers are exploiting PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) to root firewalls. It leads at 8 outlets and CISA's federal due date is tomorrow, 2026-10-29. Fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.
New: a critical 16-year-old UEFI flaw can run code before Secure Boot on network-booting servers. A new InfraTrust report also warns of exploited flaws in critical network infrastructure.

Japan's GMO told customers to shut down and disconnect their PCs from the internet after a data breach and ransomware threat (4 outlets), and is offering a $1 million bounty over its FX trading cloud breach.

CISA warns hackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell flaw. Adobe Commerce PolyShell attacks have breached hundreds of stores as Brotli exploit traffic emerges; CVE-2026-48356 (Magento) and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are in CISA KEV, due 2026-11-10.

Breaches: Northern Territory Health backtracked on its claim that only five patients were hit by the RDH breach; Bithumb, So-net (2.6M records) and 123 Reg disclosed breaches; ransomware still disrupts UNM Health.

actions: Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 before CISA's 2026-10-29 deadline, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts.
If you run Oracle E-Business Suite, apply Oracle's patch for CVE-2026-101767 now; PeopleSoft users should follow guidance for CVE-2026-35273 and review logs.
Inventory network-booting servers and apply firmware vendors' UEFI fixes as they ship; restrict PXE/network boot to trusted segments.
Find any Node2Shell-affected systems you run, apply the vendor's fix now and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento for CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497; check stores for webshells and unexpected uploads.
Apply Tailscale's SSH fixes on nodes that use Tailscale SSH.
